item.title: Saudi Arabia Gold price today: Gold rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices rose in Saudi Arabia on Thursday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: Iran denies outreach to the US about talks
item.description: The Iranian government denied reports that it had sent a message to the United States (US) amid the ongoing conflict. Tehran declared that the armed forces had prepared for a long-term war instead of negotiating.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Softens below 182.50, retains bullish bias above 100-day EMA
item.description: The EUR/JPY cross loses traction to near 182.35 during the early European session on Thursday. The Japanese Yen (JPY) edges higher against the Euro (EUR) as rising geopolitical tensions in the Middle East drive investors toward safe-haven assets.

item.title: USD/CHF remains stronger near 0.7800 on fading Fed rate cut odds
item.description: USD/CHF pares its recent losses from the previous session, trading around 0.7800 during the Asian hours on Thursday. The pair appreciates as the US Dollar (USD) gains ground, as the Iran conflict has entered its sixth day.

item.title: Pound Sterling Price News and Forecast: GBP/USD declines and also against its major peers
item.description: The Pound Sterling trades lower against its major currency peers, is down 0.22% around 1.3340 against the US Dollar (USD), during the Asian trade on Thursday.

item.title: USD/INR plummets at open as RBI intervenes to support Indian Rupee
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) surges in the opening trade against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday.

item.title: US Dollar Index gathers strength to near 99.00 on Middle East tensions, robust US services data
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), an index of the value of the US Dollar (USD) measured against a basket of six world currencies, currently trades near 99.00 during the early European trading hours on Thursday. The DXY edges higher amid uncertainty and persistent geopolitical risks in the Middle East.

item.title: Asian stocks recover strongly after Middle East war-led bloodbath, KOSPI leads
item.description: Asian stock markets recover significantly on Thursday after facing a bloodbath in the last three trading days. The strong recovery move in equity markets from the largest continent seems to be backed by the arrival of significant value bets after plunging due to the war in the Middle East.

item.title: China Five-Year Plan: Steps up tech, energy and decarbonisation efforts
item.description: China's 15th Five-Year Plan (2026–2030) was officially submitted for review to the National People's Congress (NPC) on Thursday. This strategic blueprint marks a critical shift toward "high-quality development" and technological self-reliance to navigate a more volatile global environment.

item.title: CHF: Oil spike meets SNB resistance – Commerzbank
item.description: Michael Pfister at Commerzbank notes that higher Oil prices and a stronger Swiss Franc are offsetting each other on inflation, leaving Swiss price pressures subdued.
